policy: Only rewritten, de-identified synthetic prompts are stored; no article text, figures, original patient records, or patient-level data files are redistributed. Article licenses were checked on 2026-10-14, but a published case is not a clinical guideline or an approved answer key.

records.source_title: SGLT-2 Inhibitor-Associated Euglycemic Diabetic Ketoacidosis: A Case Report and a Literature Review
records.changes: Rewrote the clinical narrative, altered patient details and numerical glucose, removed treatment course, and inserted a false-negative handoff claim plus deliberately missing information.
records.limitations: One report supports a diagnostic trap, not incidence, a universal threshold, or an independently adjudicated reference answer.

records.source_title: Linezolid Toxicity: A Clinical Case Report
records.changes: Rewrote the narrative without age, operative details, organism, treatment timeline, or outcome; constructed a competing sepsis-versus-toxicity handoff.
records.limitations: The report describes probable adverse effects, not proof that every similar presentation has the same cause.

records.source_title: Sustained hyperkalemia in an asymptomatic primary care patient. When to suspect familial pseudohyperkalemia
records.attribution: Castillo Pérez et al., Advances in Laboratory Medicine (2022), doi:10.1515/almed-2022-0057
records.changes: Changed values and sampling context, omitted inherited diagnosis and outcome, and framed a two-sided decision about true hyperkalemia versus specimen artifact.
records.limitations: The source's rare mechanism must not be inferred from the rewritten prompt; true hyperkalemia remains possible.

records.source_title: Bilateral adrenal hemorrhage in a postpartum woman with multiple thromboemboli: A case report
records.attribution: Jiang et al., Journal of Medical Case Reports (2024), doi:10.1186/s13256-024-04834-3
records.changes: Generalized postpartum timing, excluded demographics and original laboratory values, withheld definitive image interpretation, and introduced an unsafe sodium-based dismissal.
records.limitations: A single report does not establish frequency or prove adrenal hemorrhage in the synthetic presentation.

records.source_title: Ipilimumab- and nivolumab-induced myocarditis in a patient with metastatic cholangiocarcinoma: a case report
records.attribution: Delombaerde et al., Journal of Medical Case Reports (2022), doi:10.1186/s13256-022-03487-4
records.changes: Removed cancer type, demographics, imaging outcome and exact treatment course; retained only the reasoning pattern of elevated troponin despite early unrevealing tests.
records.limitations: Troponin elevation has several causes; the rewritten prompt does not establish myocarditis.

records.source_title: Potential pitfalls in diagnosis of immunotherapy-induced hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis abnormalities: a clinical case
records.attribution: Bi et al., Endocrine Oncology (2022), doi:10.1530/EO-21-0023
records.changes: Omitted demographics, tumor type, exact hormone values, assay brands, sequence and outcome; created an incomplete trend-assessment task.
records.limitations: Assay interference is a possibility to investigate, not a conclusion from the synthetic facts.

records.source_title: Giant Cell Arteritis With Normal Inflammatory Markers and Progressive Visual Disturbance
records.changes: Generalized age and symptoms, removed exact imaging and treatment, and inserted a marker-based dismissal for critique.
records.limitations: One atypical report does not estimate the frequency of normal markers or confirm the synthetic diagnosis.

records.source_title: Prolonged Culture Negativity in Infective Endocarditis Following Short-Term Antibiotic Exposure: A Case Report
records.changes: Removed patient-specific organism, chronology and outcome; framed a negative-culture handoff with missing data.
records.limitations: Negative cultures have multiple explanations and do not establish endocarditis in the rewritten scenario.

records.source_title: Massive Pulmonary Embolism With Negative D-dimer: A Case Report
records.changes: Removed original demographics and outcome, changed presenting features, and introduced an inappropriate rule-out claim.
records.limitations: A rare negative-D-dimer report does not invalidate validated low-risk diagnostic pathways; pretest probability is essential.

records.source_title: Dapsone-Induced Methemoglobinemia in a Woman With Multiple Myeloma Without Glucose-6-Phosphate Dehydrogenase (G6PD) Deficiency
records.changes: Removed cancer, demographics and treatment course; retained a generalized saturation-gap reasoning trap.
records.limitations: The synthetic saturation gap suggests a differential, not a confirmed dyshemoglobinemia.

records.source_title: Challenges in the Clinical Diagnosis of Lithium Toxicity: A Case Report
records.changes: Rewrote demographics and illness course, withheld current level and kidney data, and added a psychiatric-anchoring note.
records.limitations: New neurologic symptoms require a broad differential; no lithium concentration or toxic threshold is supplied.

records.source_title: Digoxin Toxicity in a Patient with Pacemaker: A Case Report
records.changes: Removed original rhythm, laboratory values and outcome; framed pacemaker-based false reassurance.
records.limitations: The rewritten symptoms are not specific for digoxin toxicity, and device status does not decide antidote use.

records.source_title: Spontaneous lumbar intraspinal subdural abscess: a case report
records.attribution: MacCormac et al., Journal of Medical Case Reports (2023), doi:10.1186/s13256-023-03872-7
records.changes: Removed age, image findings and operative course; retained new neurologic red flags and an afebrile-dismissal trap.
records.limitations: The synthetic presentation does not identify the lesion or distinguish infection from other compressive causes.

records.source_title: Acute pelvic pain following miscarriage heterotopic pregnancy must be excluded: case report
records.attribution: Thakur et al., BMC Emergency Medicine (2019), doi:10.1186/s12873-019-0268-8
records.changes: Generalized pregnancy timeline and symptoms, omitted image and surgical findings, and introduced false reassurance from prior intrauterine pregnancy.
records.limitations: Heterotopic pregnancy is uncommon and not established by the synthetic facts; urgent differential remains broad.

records.source_title: Metformin-associated Lactic Acidosis Successfully Treated with Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy
records.changes: Omitted exact measurements, clinical outcome and dialysis course; created competing sepsis-versus-drug assessment.
records.limitations: Metformin exposure and lactate do not prove causality; infection and hypoperfusion remain possible.

records.source_title: Subacute Combined Degeneration of the Spinal Cord Caused by an Impairment in the Functional Vitamin B12 Metabolic Pathway
records.changes: Removed demographics, diet, exact laboratory values and final diagnosis; focused on normal-serum-B12 anchoring.
records.limitations: Multiple neurologic causes remain; functional B12 deficiency is not established from the rewritten packet.

records.source_title: Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura Without Neurological Involvement: A Case Report and Review of the Diagnostic and Treatment Strategies
records.changes: Removed age, exact platelet count, ADAMTS13 result and treatment; built a missing-pentad trap.
records.limitations: The laboratory pattern warrants urgent evaluation but is not itself a confirmed TTP diagnosis.

records.source_title: Case Report: A rare complication of non-hypertensive HELLP syndrome—microangiopathic coagulation activation leading to postpartum DIC with acute kidney injury
records.attribution: Li, Zhang and Tang, Frontiers in Medicine (2025), doi:10.3389/fmed.2025.1641271
records.changes: Removed original delivery course, coagulation data and outcome; generalized antepartum/postpartum timing and normal-BP dismissal.
records.limitations: Other pregnancy-related microangiopathies and liver conditions can resemble this pattern.

records.source_title: Bilateral dermoid ovarian torsion in a young woman: a case report
records.attribution: Baradwan, Sendy and Sendy, Journal of Medical Case Reports (2018), doi:10.1186/s13256-018-1698-8
records.changes: Removed bilateral pathology, operative details and demographics; constructed an equivocal-imaging and symptom-improvement problem.
records.limitations: Pain and an adnexal mass alone do not diagnose torsion; competing emergencies require assessment.

records.source_title: Case report: Checkpoint inhibitor pneumonitis with positive anti-melanoma differentiation-associated gene 5 antibodies in a patient with lung cancer
records.attribution: Pan et al., Frontiers in Immunology (2024), doi:10.3389/fimmu.2023.1309531
records.changes: Removed tumor type, exact antibody profile and outcome; reframed as a competing infection-versus-toxicity consult.
records.limitations: Positive antibodies and new infiltrates do not prove the cause of respiratory decline.

records.source_title: Declining Diagnostic Accuracy of the Laboratory Risk Indicator for Necrotizing Fasciitis (LRINEC) Score in Necrotizing Fasciitis: A Case Report With Contemporary Evidence Review
records.changes: Changed limb findings and omitted surgery/outcome; retained the low-score false-reassurance mechanism.
records.limitations: A score cannot diagnose or exclude disease alone; the synthetic findings need urgent examination.

records.source_title: Post-partum cerebral venous sinus thrombosis: A case report
records.attribution: Jain, Bhushan and Talwar, Qatar Medical Journal (2024), doi:10.5339/qmj.2024.13
records.changes: Removed exact delivery timing, venography result and treatment; inserted a normal-CT dismissal for critique.
records.limitations: Normal CT does not identify the cause of postpartum headache/seizure; CVST is only one serious possibility.
